set.set_name: Windows of Attraction (2026, Walt Disney World)
aka: Windows of Attraction Pin of the Month 2026
set.total_pins_in_set: 12 monthly pins stated by multiple sources ('1 of 12' ... '10 of 12'); 10 identified so far. No 2026 Disney Store 'completer' pins confirmed.
set.format: Monthly Pin of the Month, one limited-edition pin per month; stained-glass arched window design themed to a park attraction
set.release_dates_waves: Monthly from 6 Jan 2026 (Pin Tuesday, usually the first Tuesday of month; October on 13 Oct). Pins 11 (Nov) and 12 (Dec) not yet announced in sources found.
regions: Walt Disney World Resort (USA) - WDW exclusive per Disney Pins Blog
set.uk_paris_relevance: No evidence of Disneyland Paris or UK (disneystore.co.uk) release found.

related_candidate_set.notes: Predecessor series NOT the 2026 set: 12 LE2500 monthly pins at Disneyland Resort from Jan 2025 (e.g. Jungle Cruise Jan, It's a Small World Mar, Peter Pan's Flight Apr, Enchanted Tiki Room May at $24.99, Matterhorn Jul, Pirates of the Caribbean Dec) plus four LE1250 quarterly 'completer' pins on DisneyStore.com (e.g. King Arthur Carrousel, Space Mountain, Star Tours, Sleeping Beauty Castle). Not catalogued pin-by-pin here; Disney Pins Blog has a 'Complete Disneyland Windows of Attraction Pin Collection' page if needed. The Disney Parks Blog (official) only mentions the Sleeping Beauty Castle pin in passing (Times Square retro pin event post).

research_notes: 'Windows of Attraction' is unambiguous: a 2025 Disneyland Resort Pin of the Month series (12 LE2500 + 4 LE1250 Disney Store completers) continued in 2026 as a Walt Disney World series of 12 monthly LE2500 pins at $26.99. 10 of 12 2026 pins identified (Jan-Oct); Nov/Dec not yet announced in any source found. No official Disney product pages or Parks Blog announcements found for the 2026 pins; no SKUs found. No DLP/UK release evidence. WebFetch could not resolve any host in this environment, so all facts come from search-engine snippets of WDWNT, Disney Pins Blog and DisneyBlog.com rather than full page reads; design/character details are therefore thin. Confidence: no pin reaches High (no official/retailer listing).
time_and_difficulty: ~25 searches. Moderate: series identity easy, but WebFetch was fully blocked (DNS failures), official sources silent, and Pin & Pop/PinPics dominate results and had to be excluded.
